nativeWebView.runtime: actual release-build WebView2 through CDP input, unpaused wall-time/frame sampling and paused geometry inspection
checks: light: interrupted scaled frame continuity, safe/cancellable exit, source/title/Escape, keyboard menu, editor handoff and focus
dark: interrupted scaled frame continuity, safe/cancellable exit, source/title/Escape, keyboard menu, editor handoff and focus
dopamine: interrupted scaled frame continuity, safe/cancellable exit, source/title/Escape, keyboard menu, editor handoff and focus
Toolbar toggle, page navigation removes closing picture, reduced motion has no animation or tail

limits: Only the core is released. Shared source/UI/business checks do not imply independently packaged plugin releases or a native remote release-package combination. Local WebView2 used isolated data, CDP input, unpaused real-time/frame sampling and paused geometry inspection. Physical pointer/IME/DPI/multi-display/screen-reader, Linux/macOS native menu gesture, historical upgrade and netem special verification were not performed.
